name: Build Night
tagline: Hands-on AI build sessions for 20 to 30 developers. The topic travels across products; your team brings the context.
bio: I'm Ravi, a staff engineer who has run monthly build nights for three years. Each one is a short, real exercise (build an agent workflow, review a real project, ship a small eval) followed by people showing what they made. I bring the exercise and the room; you bring the guests and, if you like, one of your engineers.
terms: Free to cancel up to 14 days before.
backupPlan: Two facilitators from past build nights can run the same exercise; you meet one on the prep call.

experiences.name: Build an agent workflow, together
experiences.desc: Everyone builds a small working agent in 75 minutes with starter code, then five people demo. Works with any model or framework, including yours.
includes: Room at a SoMa partner venue with power at every seat
Starter repo and a written exercise
A recap with what people built
experiences.allIn: Facilitation, room, Wi-Fi, food, drinks and tax.
experiences.av: Screen, mic, power strips at every seat, 1 Gbps Wi-Fi
experiences.dietary: Dinner has vegetarian and vegan options.
experiences.hybrid: Not hybrid; this works because people sit together.
experiences.branding: Your engineer can give a 10-minute talk; your API in the starter code if you want.
